title: Bifrost Model Router Config
description: Configuration for the pi-bifrost model router. Routes prompts to configured tiers or exact provider models. Optional classifiers can select a tier. Merged from extension defaults → global → project root → project config (.pi/bifrost.json), with later layers winning.

schemaVersion.description: Config schema version. Omit or set 1 to retain legacy routing behavior. Version 2 permits explicit per-tier fallback boundaries; each boundary is activated only by its tierPolicies entry.

tierPolicies.description: Optional strict fallback boundaries. A configured tier with fallbackTiers resolves only itself and the listed tiers in order. An empty list allows no fallback. Requires schemaVersion 2.

fallbackTiers.description: Ordered configured tier names to try after this tier. Must not include this tier, duplicates, missing tiers, or form a cycle.

economics.description: Optional local reserve signals and admission policy. Without this namespace, Bifrost keeps legacy routing behavior. Config-declared facts are declared or estimated; Pi does not query live billing or account APIs.

affinity.description: Optional explicit affinity override. When absent, the Pi extension retains a proven successful Auto-dispatch anchor within the selected tier; physical selection and the resolve-only API remain off by default. Retention stays inside the final selection pool and does not override hard exclusions. This namespace requires schemaVersion 2.

enabled.description: Enable or disable routing. When disabled, Bifrost does not switch models for new turns. Pi uses the selected physical model.

default.description: Model tier to use when no rule matches and the classifier returns no category. Must match a key in 'models'.

strategy.description: Model selection strategy. 'first'/'fastest' picks first candidate (list should be pre-sorted). 'cheapest' sorts by input+output cost. 'cheapest_input' by input cost. 'cheapest_output' by output cost. 'largest_context' by context window. 'random' picks randomly.

categoryStrategies.description: Per-tier strategy overrides. Keys must match tier names in 'models'. If a tier is not listed here, 'strategy' is used.

models.description: Model tiers. Each key is a tier name (e.g. 'quick', 'general', 'frontier'). Values are provider/model patterns — either a single string or an ordered array of candidate patterns.

rules.description: Regex-based routing rules applied in order. The first case-insensitive match names a configured tier or an exact provider/model. A bifrost-routes.json file overrides this field.

x-aiHints.danger: Wrong regex can misroute all requests. Test with /bifrost preview <prompt> before committing.

pattern.description: JavaScript regex pattern (without flags, double-escaped). Matched case-insensitively against the user's prompt. Example: '\\b(debug|fix|refactor)\\b'

model.description: Model tier name OR a direct model reference (e.g. 'provider/specific-model'). If the value contains '/', it's treated as an exact provider/id lookup and bypasses tier selection. Otherwise, it must match a key in the 'models' map.

ClassifierConfig.description: LLM-based classifier that inspects user prompts and selects a tier before falling back to regex rules. Set 'enabled: false' to use regex-only routing.

enabled.description: Enable the LLM classifier. When disabled, only regex rules are used.

backend.description: Classifier backend. If omitted, Bifrost detects Pi-managed TypeSafe credentials first, TYPESAFE_API_KEY second, and otherwise uses prompt. An explicit value always wins.

totalTimeoutMs.description: Optional total budget for external classification across direct backends, retries, and prompt fallback. When it expires, Bifrost stops external classifier attempts and continues with local regex/default routing. Caller cancellation stops routing. If omitted, backend-specific timeouts remain unchanged.

debug.description: Detailed TypeSafe operational trace with redacted metadata only; active only when global debug.enabled is true. Raw prompts, request bodies, provider responses, and external error text are never persisted.

piNative.description: Pi-native classifier settings. Omit model to use the first available TypeSafe classifier model in Pi's catalog.

model.description: Classifier model in provider/id form, for example typesafe/jev-latest.
Model pattern(s) for prompt classification. With a direct backend and prompt fallback, this is the prompt model, not the TypeSafe classifier model.

endpoint.description: Prompt backend base URL. Direct backends reject this field.

method.description: How to invoke the classifier. 'direct' uses a fast OpenAI-compatible HTTP call (needs compatible API). 'subprocess' spawns a fresh pi CLI (slower but supports any provider). 'auto' tries direct first, falls back to subprocess.

maxTokens.description: Max output tokens for the classifier. Keep it low — only need the category name back.

temperature.description: Temperature for classifier sampling. 0 for deterministic category selection.

fallbackToRegex.description: Fall back to regex rules when the classifier fails or returns an unknown category.

criteria.description: Provider-neutral criteria keyed by configured tier.

oneOf.description: Remove inherited criterion for this tier.

fallback.description: Fallback after a direct classifier miss or rejected judgment. Prompt uses classifier.model; regex skips prompt classification.

systemPrompt.description: Custom system prompt for the classifier. Override to change how categories are presented to the LLM.
systemPrompt.default: You are a routing classifier. Pick the category that best matches the task complexity and type. Respond with only the exact category name. No explanation, no punctuation.

CacheConfig.description: Fuzzy classification cache. Repeated or similar prompts reuse the cached category instead of calling the classifier again.

maxEntries.description: Maximum number of cached entries. Oldest entries (by last use) are evicted first.

threshold.description: Jaccard similarity threshold for fuzzy cache matches. 0 = any prompt sharing at least one token with an entry matches (prompts with zero token overlap never match). 1 = only exact token matches.

ttlHours.description: Classification cache retention in hours. Default: 720 (30 days).

path.description: Custom path for the cache file. Absolute, ~-prefixed, or relative to project root. Default: .pi/bifrost-cache.jsonl

ReliabilityConfig.description: Health-aware model selection and circuit breaker. Tracks repeated probe/runtime failures, opens circuits for unhealthy models, and skips them before routing.

enabled.description: Enable circuit-breaker based model health filtering.

failureThreshold.description: Open model circuit after this many failures within windowMinutes.

cooldownMinutes.description: How long an opened circuit stays open before model becomes eligible again.

cooldownOnAllowanceExhausted.description: Immediately pause a provider after a normalized explicit usage-allowance or billing failure. A 402 response pauses the provider; ordinary 429 rate limits use a short provider throttle. Set false to disable usage and billing pauses; rate-limit throttles remain enabled.

allowanceCooldownScope.description: Scope usage-allowance and billing pauses. The default provider scope pauses all configured models under the same provider ID. Set model to keep those pauses model-scoped. HTTP 429 throttles always use provider scope.

retryOnAllowanceExhausted.description: Retry at most once on a different configured model only when reliability and cooldownOnAllowanceExhausted are enabled and Pi proves the failed Auto generation had no assistant content, tool calls, tool results, or other activity. The failed response is omitted from the next model context; the raw transcript remains visible.

stateVersion.description: Reliability state format. Omitted or 1 uses the legacy runtime; 2 opts into the experimental receipt-owned runtime and requires explicit /bifrost reliability migrate preparation. Physical routing and direct utility requests are unsupported while version 2 is enabled.

enabled.description: Store allowlisted failure categories and timestamps from proven runtime failures. No provider error text is retained.

path.description: Custom path for persisted reliability state. Default: .pi/bifrost-reliability.json

DebugConfig.description: Structured debug logging. Appends JSONL lines to a file for performance analysis and troubleshooting. Disabled by default.

path.description: Custom path for the debug log file. Default: .pi/bifrost-debug.jsonl

ProbeConfig.description: Model probe tuning (/bifrost probe and /bifrost init). The probe sends a tiny prompt to every registry model; lower concurrency if providers rate-limit burst traffic.

concurrency.description: Maximum number of models probed simultaneously.

mode.description: observe reports reserve and billing preference effects without changing candidate membership, order, or random selection. policy excludes only candidates rejected by a configured hard reserve and may prefer an explicitly configured billing class among the remaining eligible candidates.

preference.description: Optional preference among final eligible candidates in the already selected tier. It does not exclude candidates or override a direct model selection. Requires fresh explicit billing facts; unknown or conflicting facts remain neutral.

authority.description: A static fact entered by the user; it is not authoritative provider billing data.

observations.description: User-entered static observations only. Values are local evidence and must be refreshed by the user; no provider adapter is invoked.

mode.description: Explicit Pi extension override: off disables affinity, observe reports the proven Auto anchor without changing selection, and retain-within-tier may keep an automatic successful-dispatch anchor only when it is in the selected tier's final selection pool. It never crosses tiers or bypasses hard exclusions.

providerAdvisory.description: Include whether any final eligible candidate shares the anchor provider. This reports candidate availability only; it does not claim cache reuse or savings.
